page.overview:
Who is ADU Pilot?

The ADU Pilot is an Alien Conquest minifigure introduced in 2011.

I’m just the guy for the job. No matter what or where, I’m always ready to hop into the nearest thing with wings and take the fight straight to the bad guys. G-forces? Disintegration beams? UFOs that can move faster than anything on the planet? They’re no match for this high-speed flyboy. Just point me at them and watch me clean up the sky!”
